about: Agency names the City's official list (readability-agency-names.json) doesn't cover, kept by hand. The second ARI leaves them out, in every article, along with the names on the official list. City: ways the articles write a City agency's name that the official list lacks. State and federal: the agencies named in the 100 NYC311 articles with the highest ARI on Oct 16, 2026, each with its official name and acronym (source) and every other way the articles write it, including its offices. A short form is listed only if every use of it in the articles means that agency.
